headline: Uzbekistan plans to introduce a rating of securities issuers
summary: Uzbekistan's National Agency for Promising Projects has developed a regulation on a rating of securities issuers. The move would add an issuer assessment framework to the country's capital markets.
why: Issuer ratings help investors compare the creditworthiness and disclosure quality of companies issuing bonds and shares.
